sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 882)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across Fanny Brice's comedic tantrums as Baby Snooks on *The Fanny Brice Show* for Maxwell House Coffee (1946), four dramatic tabloid headline adaptations on *Front Page Drama* from *The American Weekly* (ghost painter in 1935; table forensic clues in 1940; wartime tragic lovers in 1941; journalist death threats in 1953), and Peg Lynch's domestic suburban humor on *The Couple Next Door* (1960).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with credited performers, conductors, and story details recorded in the narrative description:
